Do not paint its scenery or other characters.
Redraw the entire single source cel together as one unified smooth cartoon painting on true transparent background. Keep all relative positions and source proportions. Keep source head, hand and eye sizes, negative spaces and intentional clipping. No texture, dithering, glow, shadows, floor, scenery, labels or grid. Do not complete parts that are intentionally partial. Do not mirror, rotate, rearrange or invent details. Preserve every source-colored little detached fragment and mark. Each component must be painted as part of this single whole cel, never assembled from separately generated body parts.
Source-specific meaning and invariants: Exact whole BACK VIEW phase 1812. Lee-Harvey faces directly away, brown-red quiff back with THIS source contour, tiny pink ears, no human face. Dark navy jacket/trousers, broad blue-gray shoulder panel and cuffs, straight narrow legs and dark long boots. Max short cream arm and clenched paw rise above-left of human head at the exact source height/angle; do not use a longer raised-arm phase. There are NO stars or detached impact marks in THIS frame. Preserve all original tiny face/paw details, negative gaps and partial occlusions. No new smile, white eye ovals, extra foot pads, tail, belly button, Sam fragments or floor. One whole faithful cel with clean dark smooth outlines and flat source colors.
The source palette controls the human: Lee-Harvey is a tall human thug with reddish-brown high quiff, pink skin, red shirt, nearly black/navy jacket and trousers, dark boots, blue-gray jacket edging. He is not Sam and not the blond man in the orange jacket. Max follows his approved cream fur, salmon inner ears, tiny black eyes and pink nose, but his expression, teeth, mouth and anatomy follow THIS source pose, not a generic master smile. Sam fragments, when present in Image 1, are blue-gray suit pieces of fallen Sam, not floor, a platform or boots. Only paint characters and partial pieces actually present in Image 1.
Output one 1024x1024 PNG with genuine soft antialiased alpha, no painted background. Maintain the whole original cel layout with generous transparent margin around and between all components, approximately the same framing as Image 1. Do not copy pixel stair steps or use a hard source silhouette mask. Frame costume124_1812, original complete extent 72 by 79 pixels. Every tiny gesture and attachment point belongs to this exact phase.
